text:
nat: Heads-up 1 Novaterra Health (CISO) escalated. They won't start integration until we resolve BYOK, an EU-only pilot guarantee, delegated-admin SCIM for Okta, and they want pen-test evidence + SOC2. Also asked for a firm price for a 3-month POC and a throughput SLA. Need owners and an exec bridge today.
sean: I'll take BYOK/KMS and work out the ops caveats. Quick note: we support key-wrap in Dedicated; automated BYOK for hosted needs infra work. Can do manual rotation + audit logs for POC. ETA for note: 2pm PT.
riley: I'll own infra/residency and SCIM. SCIM delegated-admin isn't supported today; we can offer scoped user/group sync or an SE-managed admin-proxy for the pilot. I'll draft the SCIM scope by 1:30pm.
jess: Legal ; pen-test and SOC2 docs require NDA for full reports. We can share redacted SOC2 pages and a summary pen-test. I'll prep a pilot addendum w/ region-processing clause and deletion-at-end language. Need customer contact for NDA.
nat: Thanks. CISO requested 180 req/s sustained and p99 <= 220ms for gen routes. Also asked for a short failover runbook and rollback plan.
sean: Perf looks feasible with a reserved pilot cluster + batching. I'll run a quick benchmark tonight if they send sanitized payloads. Nat, can you get sample payloads and their questionnaire version?
ops-bot: ticket created: NTERRA-4510 "Novaterra POC: BYOK + EU residency + SCIM + SLA" Assigned: infra-pilot, se-oncall, legal-queue.
jess: I'll queue NDA template and pilot addendum. If they insist on delegated-admin in production, that's a roadmap item; for POC we should require the proxy.
riley: Network note: any packet-capture or deep network testing needs eng-telemetry and an SOW. Also retention controls must be in addendum.
nat: I've requested sample payloads and the questionnaire (they referenced "SecReq-4"). Scheduling exec bridge for 2025-10-28 16:00 PDT. Can SE, infra, and legal join?
sean: I can join.
riley: I'll be there after 15:45.
jess: Will join. ETA for drafts: SCIM scope by 13:30, BYOK note by 14:00, addendum NDA draft by 15:00.
nat: I'll prepare a one-slide ask (asks + owners + two pricing options: metered w/ pilot discount vs reserved nodes) and drop it here by 14:30.
sean: Also flagging streaming tails may affect p99 when streaming is enabled. I'll include mitigation notes.
ops-bot: reminder: meeting scheduled 2025-10-28T16:00:00-07:00 (Novaterra Exec Bridge).
nat: Invite sent to customer and internal owners. Closing loop for now; will post questionnaire and payloads when they arrive. :white_check_mark:
